small_guidance:
- Add more autotune configs varying TILE_W with BLOCK over the (dp,hp,wp) tile: e.g. process all 8 sub-positions together by tiling output spatial coords as a single (OC, 8*TILE_W) accumulator, sharing weight loads across the 2×2×2 pool window.
- Sweep num_warps={2,4,8} with TILE_W∈{4,8,16,32} and num_stages∈{2,3,4}; current best is likely TILE_W=16 — verify and prune the config list to reduce autotune overhead.
- Cache `_get_weight_t` once at init (weights are fixed) instead of versioned check each forward, removing the per-call overhead and `.to(device)` branch.
large_guidance:
- Restructure as one program per (N, dp, hp, wp_tile) producing all 8 pool inputs at once: a single weight load is reused across the 2×2×2 window. The current kernel re-fetches the same weight 8 times per output tile — collapsing the pool loop into the GEMM reduces weight-load traffic ~8×.
- Switch to an im2col-style direct conv-transpose computation that pre-tiles over OC if OC grows; for OC=16 keep the full-OC accumulator but tile output spatially as (TILE_D, TILE_H, TILE_W) so the inner kd/kh/kw/ic loop is amortized across more outputs (better register reuse, fewer redundant valid-mask computations).
- Precompute kd/kh/stride-validity masks per output coord as compile-time tables (KD,KH small) and hoist `num%STRIDE` checks outside the IC loop (currently inside static_range so likely fine, but verify the generated PTX; consider rearranging so the IC loop is innermost over a contiguous IC tile via tl.dot for a real GEMM tile).
